name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted social media scheduler to create, schedule and publish posts across social networks, with MySQL and Redis included.

alerts.message: The first start creates an administrator with the email admin@example.com and the password changeme. Sign in right after deploying and change the password under Profile, but keep that email: if no account uses it, every restart recreates it with the default password.
Connecting a social network needs a developer app and API keys from that network, entered in Mixpost under Services.
